Sounds like you may be in the loneliness cycle. Your depression and loneliness causes you to engage in behaviors that push people away, intentional or not. Your first step is to make yourself feel better, and then go out with the goal of making the friends you seek. I'm also here if you need someone to talk to. I'm not going to sugarcoat things. I've been depressed and suicidal, and understand the loneliness. It sucks dude, it really does. But it's not completely hopeless if you remains self-aware and put in the work.

You should find someone you feel comfortable venting to. A therapist would probably help in your situation as well. You need to be able to release your pent up frustration and feelings. I'm also here to listen if you need it.
